rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=800, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-7: ONE knob changed vs iter-6 (n_iter 400->800, the per-scan Adam fit budget); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_06.json (img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct). CEILING-DOC PROBE, not another smoothing knob. Trajectory by HEADROOM (the campaign primary metric, PSNR/noise-sensitive on demo): iter-1 img_n_bf=1 hr 0.2763 (PSNR 19.47); iter-2 n_bf=3 hr 0.3276 (+0.051); iter-3 n_bf=5 hr 0.3335 (+0.006, depth HR-BEST); iter-4 img_sr->0.0005 hr 0.1998 REGRESSED; iter-5 img_sr->0.02 revert hr 0.3320 recovered; iter-6 n_bf=7 hr 0.3330 (+0.000 vs n_bf=5, SSIM +0.009 0.7705->0.7796 but hr DEAD FLAT). FAILURE MODE: the image-domain DEPTH lever (img_n_bf) has hit its HEADROOM ceiling -- depth still lifts the SSIM structural term but its hr slope collapsed to zero by n_bf=5 (slope +0.051 -> +0.006 -> 0.000). img_sr is exhausted and substrate-confirmed wrong-direction (demo wants LOOSE 0.02; tightening collapses hr). proj_n_bf is in the symmetry trap (near-identity proj sigmas -> wasted params). So all the SMOOTHING/CAPACITY axes are exhausted on hr. The remaining open question for the ceiling claim is OPTIMIZATION budget: is hr ~0.333 the half-view FBP noise-floor bound (structural), or is the per-scan Adam fit simply stopping short at n_iter=400? Per the per-image N2I knob insights (mayo_campaign_state.md): U-Net N2I OVERFITS each scan as n_iter rises (no early-stop -> demo-n2i 0.4785->0.4293 @n_iter1200), but the 6-param BILATERAL physically CANNOT overfit one scan -- so doubling its per-scan budget is the clean diagnostic the U-Net could not give: more steps either (a) lift hr -> the plateau was under-optimization, the lever is n_iter (and lr), not depth; or (b) leave hr flat at ~0.333 -> CONFIRMS the structural half-view FBP ceiling, after which iter-8+ should stop tuning and document the ceiling with a seed/pretrain_epochs invariance probe toward iter-20. Chose n_iter over (a) img_n_bf 7->9 (depth lever's hr slope is already zero -- a 4th depth step re-confirms iter-6 with near-zero EV on hr), (b) lr (would confound the budget question -- vary n_iter first at the proven lr=2.3e-3, then lr if n_iter moves hr), (c) img_kernel/img_sx/img_sy (less-informed smoothing guesses, no hr evidence). Held fixed at iter-6 values: img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02, proj_n_bf=1, kernels (proj_k=7/img_k=5), proj sigmas (1.0/2.0/0.02), img spatial sigmas (img_sx=1.5/img_sy=1.5), lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 (-> identical val split, directly comparable to iter-1..6). Wall: iter-6 ran ~260 s; doubling the per-scan fit roughly doubles the per-image loop to ~450-520 s, still well under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (under the 15-min budget). Hypothesis: hr stays ~0.333 even at n_iter=800 -- the 6-param bilateral cannot overfit and has already converged on the half-view FBP noise floor, so more fit budget yields no hr -> CONFIRMS demo bilateral N2I is at its structural ~hr 0.33 ceiling toward iter-20. If instead hr rises meaningfully (>+0.005), the plateau was optimizer-budget-limited and n_iter (then lr) becomes the live lever. PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; do NOT revert to amortized.
